tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. The homepage is dark-first; light is for docs, proposals and print.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards (StageCard), the Terminal body, nav bar on scroll.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code wells, inline `code`, the Terminal title bar, input fields.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders that only separate (decorative, not a control edge).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (ghost Button, inputs) and the Pipeline track. Holds 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes (dark 3.3:1+, light 3.3:1+).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken, agent-soft and human-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, Terminal output lines, metadata. 5.6:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: agent
tokens.usage: The AI's colour, amber gold: text, icons and marks for work the agent does (stage labels, `ok` lines, the agent dot). 5:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: agent-fill
tokens.usage: Solid fill of the primary Button and the agent Badge. Always with on-agent text, never with ink-muted.

tokens.name: on-agent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on agent-fill (10.2:1).

tokens.name: agent-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet tint behind agent content: the active StageCard, highlighted Terminal line.

tokens.name: human
tokens.usage: The human gate, steel blue: text and marks for approval points where a person decides (spec review, PR approval, production release). Use sparingly — it means 'a human signs here'. It sits close to agent in lightness, so it always carries its diamond or a word ('duyệt'), never colour alone.

tokens.name: human-fill
tokens.usage: Solid fill of the human Badge and the gate diamond in Pipeline. Always with on-human text.

tokens.name: on-human
tokens.usage: Text on human-fill (9:1).

tokens.name: human-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a gate callout. ink and human both read on it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and failed checks, text only, always with a word ('lỗi', 'failed') — never colour alone, since it sits near agent in lightness.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element. 5.5:1+ on every surface.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Dự án chạy bằng AI, duyệt bởi con người.
styles.usage: Hero headline only, once per page. Drops to display-lg under 720px.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.sample: Sáu giai đoạn, một vòng lặp

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Bạn mô tả ý tưởng. AI viết spec, code, test và triển khai — bạn duyệt ở từng cổng.
styles.usage: Hero sub-copy and section intros, max 60ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Mỗi giai đoạn kết thúc bằng một file được commit, giai đoạn sau đọc file đó.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: Không có gì lên production nếu chưa có người duyệt.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section eyebrows and stage indices. Colour agent or ink-muted.

styles.name: code
styles.sample: $ claude "viết intent.md cho trang đặt lịch"
styles.usage: Terminal lines, file names (intent.md, spec.md, plan.md) and inline code.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, Badge dot gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding (lg), Terminal line gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter, Terminal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter, gap between headline and body.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between a section header and its content.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between homepage sections (64px on mobile).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inline code, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, Terminal, StageCard.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large feature panels and the hero media frame only.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default: surfaces separate by border and tone, not shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Only the Terminal in the hero and open menus.
